announcements.text: The auto-switcher is RETIRED and no automation executes a route switch (owner order 2026-09-18). announcements.text: The ops-profile client fallback chain is now inferhub, openrouter, opencode, gemini — best-first by measured per-hop success rate. It was gemini, opencode, openrouter, inferhub, which put three hops at or below 27.8 percent success ahead of one at 99.1 percent. Any lane running on the ops profile now reaches a provider through this order. The reorder was made live by config hot-reload with no daemon restart.
